title: GShard: Scaling Giant Models with Conditional Computation
authors: D. Lepikhin, H. Lee, Y. Xu, et al. (9 authors)
before: Mixture-of-experts worked in research but was hard to distribute across accelerators.
problem: Routing tokens to experts on other devices creates communication patterns the compiler cannot infer.
breakthrough: Annotation-based sharding that lets a compiler distribute a 600B-parameter MoE automatically.
why: It made sparse models an engineering reality rather than a paper result.
next: Switch Transformer simplified the routing; Mixtral and DeepSeek inherited the approach.
inherits: Automatic sharding of expert layers across devices.
